Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

When the person settles down in the last station of duty or other than  
last station but with a change of residence-  
- (a) Self and family
- (b)
- Personal effects
- (c) Transportation of Conveyance
- (d) Composite Transfer Grant  
Actual cost of conveyance not exceeding the road mileage allowance admissible for transfer.  
Actual cost of transportation not exceeding the  
amount admissible for transfer.
